title: pseudalbizzia niopoides var. colombiana
intro: Pseudalbizzia niopoides var. colombiana, commonly known as Colombian Albizia, is a plant species native to Colombia, belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Colombian Albizia include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various gastrointestinal disorders. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
